title: Hosted assurance fan-in selected stale mutable worker pointers

failing_environment.observed: All eight fast workers passed, but whole-ledger artifacts were extracted over one shared evidence tree and stale passed.json pointers could win according to artifact extraction order.

reproduction.observed: Complete worker ledgers contained colliding mutable pointers. Forward and reverse extraction orders could therefore select different evidence for the same planned test and fingerprint.

root_cause.summary: Worker artifacts transported complete evidence ledgers into a shared extraction directory. The aggregate consumed overwritten coordination pointers instead of selecting and validating one immutable plan-bound contribution for each exact work row.

regression_propositions: forward and reverse artifact ordering produce the same imported evidence
stale and missing worker pointers cannot replace or invalidate complete immutable receipt-bound evidence
wrong plan, source, row, producer, trust, digest, or timestamp material is rejected
duplicate, mixed reuse-run, failure, missing, and irrelevant contribution sets close or fail for the exact governed reason
Windows traversal, canonical-path collision, alternate data stream, reparse point, entry-count, expanded-byte, and file-size hazards are rejected
DateTimeOffset and DateTime plan instants retain exact fractional UTC ticks under non-invariant culture
failed aggregation retains every successfully validated immutable object for exact retry adoption
the development package archive and normalized content identities remain unchanged

closure.hosted_result: passed; eight-row proof closure with one fresh deterministic worker import and seven exact trusted reuses; zero failed, missing, rejected, duplicate, or ignored contributions
closure.boundary: This closes 325-A1a only. It does not freeze 3.2.5, assign C32, create candidate or release qualification, authorize 2.5.5, or admit 3.3.
